content:
#1 It seems that there is a mistake in the definition of coverages in https://ncatlab.org/nlab/show/Segal+condition#InTermsOfSheafConditionForSimplicialObjects:
the coverage over the point \Delta[0] is empty, and for any sheaf its fiber over \Delta[0] is a singleton.
Should any coverage instead be the union of all the maps from the interval \Delta[1] and all the maps from the point \Delta[0]?
subject: Segal conditions and coverages

content: #2 Presumably, the definition should say n>0.
